name: Chameleon

review.observation: Full original: laterally flattened deep body, high casque, turret eye, compact attached spiral tail and four separate zygodactyl-looking limbs. Feet are grasping paired digit bundles rather than ordinary lizard paws; exact digit grouping remains unconfirmed. Body/feet are drawn in an unsupported walking pose with no branch, so ground contact needs explicit authoring. Broad margins.

decisions.paintingObservation: No paired projecting mammalian pinnae are depicted. Any ear opening, tympanum, protective ear flap, casque, horn, neck frill or external gill remains natural head/neck paint; none is a substitute pinna.

policyStatus: AUDIT_ONLY_CANDIDATE: production reviewed-presence.mjs still admits tail absence only.
